text: To fetch data from a table, start your query with “SELECT” and specify the columns

subject: SQL
text: you want.

subject: SQL
text: An asterisk means you want all columns.

subject: SQL
text: Next, the FROM keyword is used to pick the table.

subject: SQL
text: You can restrict which rows are returned with a WHERE clause.

subject: SQL
text: There can be one or more search criteria separated by logical words like “AND” or “OR”.

subject: SQL

subject: SQL
text: with an “ORDER BY” clause.

subject: SQL
text: You can sort a column in ascending or descending order.

subject: SQL
text: And if you want to restrict the number of rows returned by your query, specify a LIMIT.
